## The one thing only you can send
- Ascentium asked yesterday for proof of your last departure from Indonesia.
It is the one thing they are waiting on that nobody else can give them, and Immigration has already refused the stay-permit route, so they are reassessing how to cancel the permit at all. Both the tax ID revocation and the BPJS claim queue behind whichever route works. - It is one attachment, and sending it today means they can work on Monday.
